thread:
Ben (sec): Need a quick alignment — regulator requested a set of logs for incident INV-2026. We need to export 90 days of SIEM data but they want 365. Who owns retention bumps and the export path?
Alice: Which indices/streams exactly? we should be concrete before touching retention.
Ben (sec): auth.*, app.errors, network.flow, and audit.events for the INV-2026 timeframe. We can't hand over raw PII. Also needs to be encrypted with a key that the regulator can't access directly.
Carla SRE: We can't just change global retention. Two safer options: (A) one-off export snapshot to a dedicated bucket with enforced encryption + ACLs, or (B) set a short-lived retention policy on a copy index. Prefer bucket + ACL.
Dave-Infra: Agreed. Technical plan: create export-bucket in infra-project, use a dedicated KMS key (alias/redwood/siem-exports) with key policy that blocks principal access except the export service. Wrap objects with KMS. Provide regulator access via a signed URL or transfer to their S3 with their kms-wrapped envelope.
Ben (sec): We also need RBAC: only two approvers, and the export job must use an ephemeral role (1h max). Can we gate this via request + approver workflow?
Alice: Yes — propose JIT role creation via our access-proxy. Steps: 1) Create JIRA request with justification + CI link. 2) Two approvers (sec lead + infra lead). 3) Access-proxy issues ephemeral role (sts:AssumeRoleDuration=3600) scoped to export job. 4) Export job runs and writes to export-bucket. 5) Revoke role and rotate bucket ACL if needed.
Carla SRE: Also need audit hooks: CloudTrail must record the assume-role and S3 PUTs. Add a signed manifest file listing exported indices + sha256 checksums and a redwood export ticket id. Ship manifest to the bucket root.
Dave-Infra: Example minimal policy for ephemeral role (paste for infra):
```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {"Effect":"Allow","Action":["es:ESHttpGet","es:ESHttpPost"],"Resource":"arn:aws:es:us-west-2:123456789012:domain/redwood-logs/*"},
    {"Effect":"Allow","Action":["s3:PutObject"],"Resource":"arn:aws:s3:::redwood-siem-exports/*"}
  ]
}
```
Carla SRE: Good. Also enforce scrubbing: the export pipeline should run redaction rules (PII redaction, token masking). We must log what was redacted in the manifest (but not include the sensitive content).
Ben (sec): KMS question — can we use a customer-managed key (CMK) with an external key policy so the regulator can't request Decrypt but we can generate an encrypted envelope they can later unwrap with their KMS? Or should we provide the data already encrypted with their key?
Dave-Infra: Two options: 1) We encrypt with our CMK and transfer encrypted blobs; regulator must provide their key and we envelope-wrap with their public key (or perform a key exchange). 2) We encrypt with their KMS key directly during transfer (requires cross-account grants). Cross-account grant + KMS key policy is the cleanest for them to hold the key, but it's heavier to set up. For a one-off, envelope-wrapping to their public key is simpler.
Alice: Operational controls: retention bump only on the copy index/export copy. Add a short TTL on the bucket (30 days) after which objects are transitioned to Glacier and then deleted after 180 days unless a compliance hold is set. All changes must have a DR/rollback plan in the ticket.
Carla SRE: Who will own the verification that PII redaction ran correctly? We need an independent reviewer (sec + privacy). Suggest Dave run a spot-check and Ben sign off before handing artifacts out.
Ben (sec): I'll create the JIRA now: SEC-INV-4972. Assign to Dave for infra tasks, tag Carla for redaction checks, and request approvals from @Maya and @Ethan (sec leadership). Will include the regulator's requirements and transfer window.

Dave-Infra: kicked off export, scope: auth.*, app.errors, network.flow, audit.events, timeframe 2026-02-10..2026-03-10. Writing to s3://redwood-siem-exports/sec-inv-4972/. Manifest will be created at s3://redwood-siem-exports/sec-inv-4972/manifest.json.

Carla SRE: Spot-checked 3 files, redaction present and manifest entries match sha256. Good to proceed to transfer.
Ben (sec): Approvers Maya and Ethan approved in JIRA. Plan to transfer via envelope-wrap to regulator public key. Post-transfer, rotate export CMK and revoke the ephemeral role.
Alice: Add a post-mortem-lite doc in the ticket describing lessons and whether retention policy needs permanent change for this class of incidents.
Ben (sec): Thanks all. Filing a follow-up item to update the export playbook with exact step numbers and permission templates. :thumbsup:
